giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.description: A massive cave spider with a low, forward-facing silhouette, a plated dark-brown abdomen, an almost black cephalothorax, copper-jointed angular legs, ivory chelicerae, and a threatening cluster of ruby-red eyes.

orc_raider.name: Orc Raider
orc_raider.description: A stocky moss-green raider with yellow eyes, ivory tusks, a short dark crest, worn asymmetrical leather and iron armor, a single spiked pauldron, bone trophies at the belt, and a broad notched crescent axe.

orc_berserker.name: Orc Berserker
orc_berserker.description: A massive hunched berserker with olive-green skin, ember-red eyes, ivory tusks, a roaring scarred face, a short dark-red crest, patched rust-red leather, spiked iron plates, heavy wrappings, and an enormous chipped two-handed axe.

kobold_trapper.name: Kobold Trapper
kobold_trapper.description: A small wiry rust-red reptilian trapper with a long toothy snout, amber eye, backward dark head spines, a ragged hide hood, leather straps and pouches, a barbed dagger, a coiled snare rope, clawed feet, and a long counterbalancing tail.

kobold_sparkmage.name: Kobold Sparkmage
kobold_sparkmage.description: A small rust-red reptilian caster with a long toothy snout, backward head spines, cyan-glowing eyes, ragged brown leather mage robes, copper charms, clawed feet, a long tail, and blue-white electrical arcs crawling over both bare hands.

gnoll_hunter.name: Gnoll Hunter
gnoll_hunter.description: A tall lean hyena humanoid with mottled ochre-brown fur, a dark bristled mane, pointed ears, an amber eye, a long fanged muzzle, crude rawhide and bone gear, a scratched round wooden shield, a dark-tipped hunting spear, and digitigrade clawed feet.

gnoll_bonecaller.name: Gnoll Bonecaller
gnoll_bonecaller.description: A hunched ochre-brown hyena shaman with a dark bristled mane, long fanged muzzle, worn hide garments, tooth and bone amulets, digitigrade claws, a twisted skull-and-bone ritual focus, and sickly emerald spirit flame around both the focus and free hand.

wight_knight.name: Wight Knight
wight_knight.description: A tall rigid undead knight enclosed in blackened blue-steel plate armor, with a pointed closed helm and violet eye slit, layered gorget and pauldrons, a clawed gauntlet, a shredded near-black purple cloak, and a broad spectral Graveblade with an icy cyan core and magenta-violet edges.

ghoul_stalker.name: Ghoul Stalker
ghoul_stalker.description: A feral hunched undead predator with taut ash-gray cadaver skin, a scarred bald skull, sparse stringy black hair, pointed ears, glowing amber eyes, a broad fanged mouth, extremely long arms, oversized clawed hands and feet, bent legs, ragged brown burial wraps, and a decayed hide shroud.

zombie_brute.name: Zombie Brute
zombie_brute.description: A colossal asymmetrical undead brute with leathery gray-brown cadaver skin, a scarred bald head, sparse dark hair, milky eyes, broken yellow teeth, swollen shoulders, enormous arms and fists, a ragged slate-blue tabard, torn brown trousers and wraps, a heavy belt, broken wrist chains, and massive bare feet.

shadow_imp.name: Shadow Imp
shadow_imp.description: A small wiry fiend with near-black violet reptilian skin, tall ridged horns, long pointed ears, glowing magenta eyes, thin sharp teeth, elongated claws, a ragged bat wing, a curled tail, a torn brown loincloth, metal bands, and luminous purple shadow flame clinging to its body.

brimstone_imp.name: Brimstone Imp
brimstone_imp.description: A small muscular fiend covered in rust-red scales cracked with ember-orange light, with a crown of ridged horns and spikes, long pointed ears, glowing amber eyes, serrated teeth, black-tipped claws, one ragged red bat wing, a burning spined tail, brown wraps, and a skull-charmed loincloth.

lesser_demon.name: Lesser Demon
lesser_demon.description: A tall muscular fiend with dark rust-red scales cracked by molten orange veins, massive curved black horns, facial spikes, glowing orange eyes, a broad fanged maw, one enormous ragged wing, long black claws, cloven hooves, a bladed spined tail, iron bracers, chains, skull trophies, and a torn black loincloth.

forest_sprite.name: Forest Sprite
forest_sprite.description: A tiny wiry forest fae with warm bark-like skin, amber eyes, a mischievous smile, enormous pointed ears, olive leaf hair crowned by twig antlers, four translucent gold-veined wings, layered leaf garments, vine wraps, twig-like clawed feet, and a short thorny branch focus.

pixie_trickster.name: Pixie Trickster
pixie_trickster.description: A tiny feminine fae duelist with warm skin, long pointed ears, violet eyes, a sly smile, short swept purple hair, curled blue antennae with gold fittings, four translucent blue-lilac wings, a blue feather collar, a purple petal outfit, curled boots, gold bells and gems, and a slim silver needle dagger.

satyr_duelist.name: Satyr Duelist
satyr_duelist.description: A lean athletic satyr with warm tan skin, swept dark-brown hair, matching sideburns and goatee, pointed ears, amber eyes, curling segmented ram horns, an ornate brown-and-gold leather vest and bracers, rolled pale sleeves, layered belts, a long gold-trimmed purple sash, shaggy goat legs, cloven hooves, and a slim silver rapier.

dryad_thornweaver.name: Dryad Thornweaver
dryad_thornweaver.description: A lithe female tree spirit with copper-brown bark anatomy, luminous yellow-green eyes, pointed ears, a crown of bare branching antlers, tangled olive foliage, small white flowers, a layered leaf skirt, rooted claw-like feet, an elongated branch-claw, and a living thorn whip coiled in her right hand.

fae_blade_dancer.name: Fae Blade Dancer
fae_blade_dancer.description: An athletic female fae with warm tan skin, bright blue eyes, very long pointed ears, voluminous violet hair, four translucent blue-lilac veined wings, ornate deep-blue and silver leaf-filigree armor, purple-gold ribbon streamers, armored bark-brown lower legs, and two matching silver crescent blades set with blue gems.

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire_wolf.description: An enormous low-slung wolf with charcoal-gray and deep-brown fur, a heavy black-brown spiked mane over its head and spine, fierce amber eyes, pale gray-beige muzzle and brow markings, a broad black nose, ivory teeth, lighter muscular forelegs, oversized splayed paws with long black claws, dark hindquarters, and a thick heavy tail.

owlbear_cub.name: Owlbear Cub
owlbear_cub.description: A compact juvenile owlbear with a hulking russet-brown bear body, a dense mantle of layered tawny feathers over its head, shoulders, and spine, a round cream-and-cinnamon owl facial disk, fierce amber eyes, pointed ear tufts, a glossy black hooked beak, thick muscular legs, broad splayed paws, and oversized black claws.

cave_troll.name: Cave Troll
cave_troll.description: An enormous hunched cave troll with gray stone-like skin armored in irregular boulder scales, knobs, and small dorsal spikes, a coarse black-brown mane, narrowed amber eyes, pointed ears, a broad flattened nose, two long ivory lower tusks, massive shoulders, elongated clawed arms, thick bent legs, wide three-toed feet, ragged hide and rope wrappings, a bone-and-skull necklace, and a heavy knotted wooden club with a bulbous spiked head.

hill_giant_youth.name: Hill Giant Youth
hill_giant_youth.description: A towering young hill giant with a broad, heavily muscled frame, weathered tan-ochre skin, a stern square face beneath a heavy brow, pointed ears, a shaggy dark-brown mane with two beaded front braids, a stitched and ragged brown hide tunic with a rough shoulder pelt, rope belt and limb wraps, a leather pouch, a tooth necklace, oversized bare five-toed feet, and one immense two-handed maul made from a wooden trunk capped by a single irregular gray boulder lashed in thick rope.

minotaur_guardian.name: Minotaur Guardian
minotaur_guardian.description: A massive bull-headed guardian with dense dark-brown fur, a thick black-brown mane and beard, fierce amber eyes, a broad bovine muzzle pierced by a gold nose ring, two long symmetrical ivory-brown horns curling upward and outward, pointed bull ears, cloven hooves, and a visible tufted tail. Ornate aged-bronze armor engraved with angular labyrinth motifs covers the chest, asymmetric right shoulder, forearms, belt, and lower legs above a layered leather war skirt, while one ceremonial long-shafted labyrinth axe carries an elaborate double-bladed steel head with bronze geometric fittings.

ogre_marauder.name: Ogre Marauder
ogre_marauder.description: An enormous hunched ogre with pale olive-beige warty skin, massively muscled long arms, oversized hands, broad bare five-toed feet, a mostly bald knobbled scalp beneath a swept-back dark-brown crest, pointed ears, amber eyes, a flattened nose, two long lower ivory tusks, and uneven smaller teeth. A ragged brown leather-and-fur tunic, torn rust-red loincloth, diagonal spiked leather harness, heavy bracers, belt pouches, bone charms, and a skull pendant mark him as a brutal marauder, while one two-handed maul combines a leather-wrapped wooden shaft with a single irregular gray boulder locked inside a riveted, spiked dark-iron cage.

lizardfolk_scout.name: Lizardfolk Scout
lizardfolk_scout.description: An athletic upright reptilian scout with olive-ochre scales broken by dark slate plate markings, a broad low snout, one visible amber slit-pupil eye beneath a ridged brow, a swept line of brown-gold hornlike spines running from the skull down the back and long muscular tail, digitigrade legs, and broad clawed hands and feet. Weathered brown leather armor combines a heavy right pauldron, diagonal buckled chest harness, bracers, ragged waist panels, and wrapped lower legs, while exactly one long wooden javelin carries a lashed angular gray spearhead and fiber ties, and one round wooden shield bears a rope-bound rim, pale chevron-and-diamond pattern, and central iron boss.
